answer: Give every identity a vine of linked attestations: each epoch it must extend its own vine with fresh verified work, and each new link must continue the thread of the one before it, so work done for one identity never counts for another. Standing rises like a terrace: higher tiers unlock only after sustained work at the level below, and a farm cannot shortcut the climb by running many bare identities in parallel, because every step costs its own time-stamped effort, and a single missed proof prunes the vine from that epoch's rewards.、
